summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Variable Pay System for Kora OS. All 4 payment types (Overtime, Commissions, Bonuses, Incentives) are fully functional with separate tabs, create dialogs, and run detail views. Employee Profile compensation fields (commission_rate, incentive_pool_percentage) are working. Settings > Item Types shows is_commissionable field. All 12 backend API tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dialog component in VariablePaySection.js should have aria-describedby for accessibility (minor)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing Variable Pay Runs and employee María González
context_for_next_testing_agent: Variable Pay System fully functional. Tests cover: 1) 4 tabs (Overtime/Commissions/Bonuses/Incentives), 2) Create dialogs with manual entry for bonus and pool distribution for incentive, 3) Run detail view with employee breakdown, 4) CSV bank file download, 5) Employee Profile compensation tab with commission_rate and incentive_pool_percentage fields, 6) Settings > Item Types with is_commissionable field. María González has commission_rate=5% and incentive_pool_percentage=25% configured.
